_about: HF105 item A - THE DIRECTION TABLE for enum packet registries (Create/catnip shape: an enum whose constants carry a payload class + codec and whose registry construction carries (modId, version); no direction of its own). The walk consults these rules IN ORDER when it needs a payload class's direction; the first rule that decides wins; no rule deciding keeps the 'no flow marker' abstain naming the rules tried. Every row cites the fixture jar (the REAL file name + its sha1, and the trimmed test fixture + its sha1) and the class the shape was read from (javap over the real bytes, 2026-10-18). Rule shapes not exhibited by a cited fixture (a direction-valued constant on the payload type or the enum constant, a boolean construction argument of the registry entry, the registrar call shape) are NOT listed: a row without a cited fixture is a guess.
